images.caption: Around Ahakista. An Air India aircraft went down in this area in the 1980s and the Irish and Canadians build a memorial garden in honour of those that lost their lives. This view is taken from the garden looking more or less north west away from the sea. Besides the site of the memorial, this square is mostly sea with the land being uncultivated and utilised for pasture and residences.
